purpose: Advance three independent acquisition gates in parallel: Titanic known-target calibration data, exact Africa frozen-point marine measurements, and exact Palomar XE325 exposure-time sky geometry.

dataset.source: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information

TITANIC.firewall: Raw multibeam bathymetry plus SVP can test real-ocean localization, geometry and path corrections, but it is not equivalent to a complex target transfer function H_target(f) and does not by itself test the project 520 Hz resonator prior.

AFRICA.important_boundary: This clean NO applies to the documented GA08 3S section. A complete file-level audit of every M121 raw ping is still required before claiming the entire cruise never approached closer on another transit leg.

event.semantic_firewall: Nine apparent transient photographic detections; not nine established unusual stars and not an established extraterrestrial phenomenon.

primary_time_sources_located: Caltech Palomar Observatory Observing Schedule Survey Log, 1949-June 1953, including plate log
MAST DSS Plate Finder plate Epoch metadata
PALOMAR.meaning: If a primary plate log or FITS/plate header confirms an exposure near 02:30 local time, a literal same-instant surface line-of-sight from the frozen Africa point to the XE325 field is rejected. This tests viewing geometry only and does not establish or refute broader causal hypotheses.

scientific_meaning.TITANIC: The public-data problem is smaller than before: raw real-ocean multibeam and sound-speed profiles exist and can already support the geometry/path part of CST-EXP-03. The phase-resolved target-transfer part remains open.
scientific_meaning.AFRICA: The first plausible nearby cruise candidate did not collapse onto the frozen coordinate. It becomes a regional control rather than local evidence, demonstrating that the NO_RECENTERING rule is working.
scientific_meaning.PALOMAR: A potentially decisive negative line-of-sight result is visible in a secondary time lead, but the gate remains deliberately open until a primary archival exposure time is recovered.

next_actions: Download or enumerate Titanic 2004 raw XSE files plus SVP and design a blind localization/geometry subset and withheld subset.
Continue searching for phase-resolved or target-strength Titanic sonar products and exact sonar waveform/calibration metadata.
Execute file-level minimum-distance audit on M121 raw navigation and exact geometry queries against NOAA/NCEI and GMRT around the frozen coordinate.
Recover the primary XE325 exposure start/end UTC from Caltech plate log, MAST plate metadata or plate/FITS header; only then freeze final Palomar alt-az, Sun, Moon and Earth-shadow geometry.
